lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [urgent, close to the mic] You have forty seconds to find the key that could save Titanic.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [hushed, quick] You're in the crow's nest, freezing. The binoculars should be in this box. Locked.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [matter-of-fact] Lee doesn't even look up. [gruff, bored sailor voice] 'No glasses tonight, mate. Ship can't sink anyway.'

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [tense] Thirty seconds. You check every pocket. Nothing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [quiet, urgent] The sea is dead flat. No waves breaking on the ice... you won't see it till it's close.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [casual] You reach for your phone light... [dry, deadpan] right. Nineteen twelve.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [fast, tense] Twenty seconds. Here's the problem. Five days ago, the officer with the key got bumped off this crew.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [bitter] He walked off the ship... with the key in his pocket.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [uneasy] Then Fleet leans over the rim. [squinting, uneasy sailor voice] '...What's that?'

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [stunned, quiet] There was never a key to find. [dry] It sold in 2007... for ninety thousand pounds.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [urgent, close to the mic] So this time...
